issues.description: The supplied Stata files consume, but do not construct, the required csr_gd3, gd2v_re10re1, bad_ave, gd_rating_eyear, and gd_rating_year datasets. The package inventory contains identifiers.dta but no Data directory or prepared panel/aggregates. The datasheet describes manual and commercial sources but provides no field-level producer, joins, cardinalities, complete date history, or mapping to these analysis files. Figure 2's rating10/review1date ownership across its two joined files is also unconfirmed.

Both programs define a relative Data path, change into it, and then continue to prefix reads, writes, graph exports, table outputs and removals with that relative path; this leaves an inconsistent effective root. The 129-line working-copy edit inventory sets package-root execution, keeps explicit GD-prefixed inputs/outputs under Data, leaves bare mahapicks/mahapicks2 intermediates at the package root, uses forward slashes, and changes five Windows-only EMF suffixes to PDF.
Seven active appendix lines use e(smaple) after regressions. The source-supported one-token working-copy correction is e(sample), preserving each intended estimation-sample restriction.

The supplied main matching loop uses mahapick and mahaselectunique to produce matching files, then reads and merges them on permno _prime_id _matchnum. These add-on versions were not found on checked paths, so their version-specific help/documentation and output-interface compatibility with the consuming merge must be confirmed after setup. The generated files are not missing external inputs, and the source sequence does not require an independently reconstructed author program.

Figure 2 joins gd_rating_eyear and gd2v_re10re1 by permno; later code uses rating10 and review1date, but both input schemas are absent. The supplied source does not assign either post-join field to a specific file. rating103g is generated later from rating10 and is not a separate raw input requirement.

Nine quoted dataset-description lines in the two do-files are not prefixed by Stata comment markers. In working copies prefix main lines 15-19 and appendix lines 16-19 with `* ` while preserving their wording; the Stata 18 manual says a leading `*` makes the line ignored.

The main program has one table call and the appendix has two calls using legacy c() syntax. Stata redesigned table in version 17 and preserves old behavior under version control; apply a per-call `version 16:` prefix to all three calls, preserving their options.

The main script contains five .emf graph exports, while the checked Stata 18 runtime is Linux. Stata documents EMF as a Windows export format and PDF as a vector format; change only each output suffix to .pdf.

evidence.quote:
This online appendix contains two components. First, in Appendix A1 we describe the Glassdoor
review data and provide evidence that Glassdoor reviews improve for our sample firms over time,
especially for those with initial negative reviews. We then show that such an improvement reflects
real changes in workplace practices rather than sheer manipulation by firms. Second, in Appendix
A2 we present evidence showing that our generalized difference-in-differences research design is
valid and our results are robust.
